name: Drunkard
overview: Scripture clearly portrays the drunkard as one who embodies stubbornness, rebellion, and moral failure, as seen in Deuteronomy where such behavior leads to severe consequences to remove evil from the community. The drunkard is also linked to poverty and ruin, described in Proverbs as one who will come to poverty and be clothed in rags due to drowsiness. Isaiah condemns the pride and downfall of those overcome by wine, illustrating the spiritual and social decay that accompanies drunkenness. Additionally, Psalms acknowledges the presence and influence of drunkards in society, underscoring the need for holiness and sobriety among God's people.
